text_block_list.text:
One day, Эль Кондор Паса and Grass
Wonder are
training on their own.
Huff, puff...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You're just running recklessly... You
need to pace
yourself.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... I know my trainer worked hard
to come
up with this training plan, but I
just can't do it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I got it! What about that over there?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Hang on, El...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Waaa-taaa!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Soaring into the ring with her fists of
fury... the
Condor Monk is hereee!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I was wondering where you went... Why
did you
change your clothes?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Silly Grass! You just don't get it.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But that's okay, I'll just explain—or better yet, I'll show you!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Waaa-chaaa!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса shouts and then dashes a
lap
around the track.

How was that?! Behold, the spirit and
stamina of
the Condor Monk! I feel
power coursin' through
me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Incredible... But, how?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to my outfit!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
When I wear the clothes of a powerful
monk, I
inherit that strength!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
For a warrior, an outfit is a kind of
beacon
guiding them to their goals. It's
also a reminder to
work hard and fulfill
your dreams!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I think this is what my papa meant when
he would
tell me about his wrestling
outfits!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I see. I think I can understand that.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: When I put on a kimono, I feel at peace.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! Now you're gettin' it! Sometimes,
you gotta
dress for the part you want!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna wear all kinds of outfits and
become
the hella strong, hella
unbeatable Эль Кондор Паса!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. What should I wear next to get
even
stronger?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Perfect timing!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! Now, what kind of outfit
should I
wear to get stronger?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: A kimono could help you keep your calm.

text_block_list.text: I see! In that case...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I want Grass to teach me everything
about
kimonos!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
With pleasure. I'll choose something that
suits you
well. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Why not work on having a Japanese
mindset as
well? It might help you stay
calm.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oooh! What should I do exactly?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
First, you should work on sitting
properly. I think
it'll help you relax and
stay calm.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Y-you mean sitting on top of my legs?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But it makes my legs tingle... Well, if it'll
make me
stronger, then... Nnngh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! A martial arts uniform! Just like in
the old
movies!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The kind you'd wear when you thrust
your fist into
a waterfall!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Let's do it right now! I'll split that
waterfall with
this here fist!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I feel like those who train under
waterfalls are
usually on a spiritual
journey, not a physical one...
More
importantly, where are you planning on

finding a waterfall?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Good point! There aren't really any
close by...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh well. Just wearing the outfit should
be enough
to feel differently, right?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That's true! Thank you, Grass! I almost
lost sight
of that!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Let's do some training in a martial arts
uniform
next! Even if it's not quite as
effective as training
under a waterfall,
I'm sure we'll see results!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса struggles with paying the
price for
strength.

A few days later, Эль Кондор Паса tells
me how
much fun she had training
dressed up as a martial
artist.
